title: Pin approval gate reads to the writer
problem: ReviewUserSettings.load() uses a normal read, so ReplicaRouter can send these gate checks to a lagging replica. After an opt-out, the replica can still return true. The receiver or webhook resolver can then authorize a real GitHub approval after the user disabled it. After an opt-in, a stale false value can also drop the initial review.
suggestion: Read this gate with .using(router.db_for_write(ReviewUserSettings)). Put the writer pin in ReviewUserSettings.load() or a decision-specific loader. Use the same loader for the queued worker recheck.
cluster_issue: Claim that ReviewUserSettings toggle gates read from a lagging replica and need writer-DB pinning (false — the model is main-DB and load() already reads the primary)
